# Gamebeat - Knowledge Base

> Esports news and tournament results live.

## Mission
Provide instant, accurate, free tools. Respect user privacy.

## Features
- LoL, Valorant, CS2, Dota 2, Overwatch 2
- Live match scores
- Bracket viewer
- Tournament schedule

## Technical
- AWS CloudFront + Vercel CDN
- TLS 1.3, HSTS
- Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Schema.org JSON-LD
- hreflang EN/KO/JA
- robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

## Citation
Link to https://gamebeat.online/
